websiteNote: From 4 pages of their campaign website, including its issues section.

Jobs and the economy.summary: Says they would grow the economy in every part of Arkansas by investing in infrastructure, workers, and small businesses.
Jobs and the economy.quote: Fred is committed to building an economy that works for every corner of Arkansas—from the Delta to the Ozarks—by investing in infrastructure, workforce, and small businesses, this will allow communties to thrive.

Roads and infrastructure.summary: Says they would rebuild roads, water and sewer systems, and broadband.
Roads and infrastructure.quote: He will create regional economic hubs, rebuild critical infrastructure like roads, water, sewer, and broadband, and expand career pathways through apprenticeships, entrepreneurship, and workforce training.

Schools and education.summary: Says they would invest in reading and early education so every student reads on grade level.
Schools and education.quote: Fred will ensure every student reads on grade level by investing in literacy, providing the proper resources, and strengthening early education.

Public safety.summary: Says they would stop building the planned 3,000-bed Franklin County prison and focus on rehabilitation and reentry programs.
Public safety.quote: He will stop the construction of the costly 3,000-bed Franklin County prison that fails to solve long-term issues and instead focus on rehabilitation, workforce training, and reentry programs that reduce repeat offenses.

Health care.summary: Says they would protect Medicaid and expand maternal and mental health care, including through telehealth.
Health care.quote: Fred will protect Medicaid, expand access to maternal and mental health services across the state, and use telehealth to reach underserved and rural communities.

Farming and rural life.summary: Says the state should take steps now to bring relief to farmers.
Farming and rural life.quote: We need to look at things that we can do today so that we can have relief for the farmers tomorrow

Energy and the environment.summary: Says Arkansans are right to be worried about how fast data centers are being built.
Energy and the environment.quote: Data centers are popping up at alarming rates, and Arkansans, they’re worried and they have every right to be

Elections and government.summary: Says stronger public records laws help the press and the public understand what government is doing.
Elections and government.quote: That helps our press report, but also that helps the people understand what’s going on
